event.title: Deep Matters 2026
event.about: The Deep Matters conference series is back! This year, we explore how AI agents are transforming the way science is done — from generating hypotheses and making decisions to running simulations and experiments. Don't miss this one-day event for everyone across academia, industry and startups.
